quest.title: Secret Identity
quest.description: You were here at Yae Publishing House to keep watch, but...

talks.objective: Go to Yae Publishing House and keep watch
Talk to the fan club members

dialogues.speaker: Nobuhiro
dialogues.text: I've been following Ms. Hina's column since the very first issue of "That's Life."

talks.objective: Go back and look for Gorou

dialogues.speaker: Hiroshi
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Ms. Hina Fan Club!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Hmm? I thought you were going to survey the scene at Yae Publishing House?

talks.objective: Go to Yae Publishing House with Gorou to deliver the replies

dialogues.speaker: Yuka
dialogues.text: I don't know if you know the word "fan"? A friendly adventurer lady taught it to us a few years ago. She seemed to know everything.
